result.summary: Analyzed the food delivery app page for visual defects. Found 2 minor issues related to content truncation and text readability; no critical or major issues detected.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant's name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and incomplete (missing the final 'o').
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container width or enable text wrapping to display the full restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' without truncation.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' banner has a semi-transparent overlay that reduces text contrast between the white promotional text and green background, slightly impairing readability.
issues.suggestion: Reduce the opacity of the overlay or increase the text contrast to ensure the promotional content is easily readable.
